observations.why: The first-person plural with a decisive active verb enacts a decision on behalf of the group, performing authority over the collective's direction.
The justification is framed entirely as proportional benefit — quantitative performance gain and cost reduction — the cost/benefit calculus of market-pricing.
The arrow notation enacts a unilateral directive of replacement, a command-shaped allocation of the technology stack.
Quantified proportional gain — the performance benefit expressed as a multiplier — is market-pricing's proportionality calculus.
Setting a deadline is a rank-based allocation of time — the speaker commits the group to a schedule, enacting authority over the timeline.
